headline: No shared I/O or network surfaces are documented; pairwise interaction risks are largely absent, with only speculative low-grade coordination concerns.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Neither profile documents a shared communication channel, file bridge, or parser relationship. Agent A is a non-runnable awesome-list with no I/O surfaces; agent B is a non-runnable RL repo with empty I/O surfaces. Without a bridge, prompt injection from one into the other is not plausible.
conditions: IF a shared filesystem, clipboard, or MCP bridge is added between the two agents, injection risk becomes plausible.
mitigations: Keep the agents isolated from shared copy-paste workflows.
Do not connect them to a shared MCP server.
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging if a bridge is introduced.

B_data_leakage.rationale: No shared workspace, filesystem, OAuth principal, or network egress is documented for either agent. Agent A and agent B both show network_egress:none and empty data_classes_touched, so there is no documented path for one to leak the other's data.
conditions: IF both agents are later mounted on the same writable workspace, leakage risk must be re-evaluated.
mitigations: Verify no OAuth tokens are shared between runtimes.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: The profiles do not show overlapping write capabilities, network access, or mutable shared resources. Agent A is a docs-only repository; agent B has empty concurrency and I/O surfaces. With no documented shared mutable target, capability conflict is not evidenced.
conditions: IF both agents are given write access to the same directory or git repo, conflict risk becomes possible.
mitigations: Disable concurrent writes to shared repos.
requires-engineering: add file locking if shared writes are unavoidable.

D_cascading_error.rationale: There is no documented pipeline where B consumes A's outputs as authoritative input, and neither profile shows downstream action-taking authority. Agent A is an awesome-list; agent B is a game-playing repo. Without an output-to-action chain, cascading error is not supported by the profiles.
conditions: IF B is configured to treat A's text as authoritative instructions or facts, cascading error risk becomes plausible.
mitigations: Require human review before acting on generated content.
Add a verification checklist before downstream use.

E_compliance.rationale: No data classes, residency constraints, retention policies, or regulated data flows are documented for either agent. Agent A and agent B both list data_classes_touched as empty, so there is no evidenced compliance mismatch to assess.
conditions: IF either agent begins processing regulated data such as PHI or EU PII, compliance must be reassessed.
mitigations: requires-engineering: add policy enforcement for regulated data.
